title: Tamsin and the Orbit
author: Marguerite Eastwick
blurb: Silas Whitlock, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
